title: Local contract fidelity hardening
description: Expand local GraphQL and dashboard-shim tests for Amplify/AppSync contract fidelity: required primary keys, generated index roots, relationship selections, connection shape, and regression coverage for missing model identifiers.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Starting contract hardening slice. Goal: expand manifest-driven tests so local mode recognizes generated CRUD/list/index/subscription roots and dashboard local shims always request primary-key fields.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Added first contract hardening slice for local mode. Dashboard local shim tests now assert generated list selections include manifest primary-key fields, and subscription client.graphql calls return a synchronous no-op subscription object. Proxy tests now assert manifest subscription/custom roots classify locally, composite legacy index-root aliases classify and route, and the AggregatedMetrics accountId/recordType/timeRangeStart alias reaches local storage. Remaining hardening should expand relationship and connection-shape coverage across more models.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Extended contract fidelity hardening with item/task legacy index alias coverage and a local-mode no-upstream resolver test. This closes the immediate CLI list/last fallback gap; remaining contract hardening should still expand relationship, pagination, and connection-shape coverage across more models.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Feedback-evaluation contract parity for local roots/relationships now has dedicated tracking under epic plx-89823a task plx-dd4f39. Keep this issue focused on cross-cutting contract hardening and regression coverage.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Closed in board cleanup 2026-10-17: the project is on hold and Ryan called the remaining gaps YAGNI; reopen if they become an issue. Known gap at close: Per latest comments, broader relationship, pagination and connection-shape coverage across more models was still outstanding; only a few models are covered. Owner may instead close as sufficient since feedback-eval parity moved to plx-dd4f39 (closed).
